fields.name: Biodiversity
fields.description: Focuses on AI systems used for species detection, habitat mapping, conservation prioritisation, or ecological monitoring—where failures often stem from biased datasets, misclassification, or poor generalisation across ecosystems.

fields.name: Flooding
fields.description: Covers flood-risk modelling, hydrological prediction, early-warning systems, and mapping tools. Failures often involve outdated data, incorrect assumptions, or over-confident visualisations.

fields.name: Urban Planning
fields.description: Includes land-use classification, zoning support tools, transport modelling, and infrastructure risk assessments. Failures may arise from scale mismatches, missing socioeconomic context, or misinterpreted outputs.

fields.name: Wildfire Risk & Management
fields.description: AI used for fire-risk prediction, smoke-plume modelling, or satellite-based detection. Failures can involve false positives/negatives, poor transfer to new regions, or miscommunication of uncertainty.

fields.name: Agricultural & Land-Use Monitoring
fields.description: Systems for crop health detection, soil moisture estimation, yield prediction, or automated irrigation. Failures often relate to seasonal bias, sensor limitations, or models trained on non-representative climates.
